release_notes: New app: 911 Inspection Dimensions reads every PART SKETCH drawing in a batch's nest packages and types the dimensions onto each part's QF-QU-09 inspection tab - the drawings are pictures with no real text, so it reads them by looking, entirely on your machine. Weld prep codes are captured with the side each applies to, REF dimensions and note text are excluded and listed separately, a tab that already has numbers is never touched, and TYP dimensions land last so you can copy them down for the repeats. It's early and experimental - check its work while you get a feel for it. 922 Setup gains a Pallet Labeler stage (off by default) that puts pallet labels on Teams cards posted before the Pallet & Rod Organizer was filled in. All 922 apps now take their batch by picking the Batch folder instead of typing a number, and a queued run asks once. FormingFinder gathers formed flat bars alongside formed plates and Kitting tags them FORMED; Kitting also stops before printing if any kit line is missing its source material. The Difficulty Stamper strips the blue label off the drawing once the packet is stamped, so the flag lives in one place. Customer DXF Analysis feedback fixes: apply one thickness to every file at once, holes and slots drawn as old-style polylines now get offsets, the Adjust Dimensions dialog prefills the correct guideline amount for your plate, offset failures are reported per feature with reasons, and re-offsetting an already-offset file warns you first. Updates that fail to download can be retried, and after a crash the next start offers a one-click debug report.
